w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE REDACTOR! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Loud-Eyes, The Focus Group, The Ugly Beast, The Redactor) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Spool stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 20 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
A weathered trader waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"

📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: The Witness. Three witnesses describe last night's attack on the trap-line. Two are true memories. One the System wrote. Name the fabrication — the village arms for whatever you name."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/9/7), with 7 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
